# Feature: V6 Konstrukt Play UI

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-03 — issue #347 -->

## Intent
Play presentation for V6 Constructs (Konstrukte): zone on playmat, challenge targeting, disturbed overlay, Haltbarkeit always visible, toast on replace. Activation stays on existing Formel aktivieren (EK Beschwörung). No Default-Flip; no 105 catalog expand.

## Preconditions
- Match with `v6Formula` / `meta.v6FormulaEnabled`
- Engine construct state from #346 (`player.construct`)
- Playtest EK Beschwörung available for summon tests

## Happy Path
- [ ] Own + opponent Konstrukt-Zone visible on playmat (empty slot or occupied face, like Formelplätze)
- [ ] Occupied: name + Haltbarkeit number always visible; disturbed shows „gestört“ overlay like Formel
- [ ] Activation via existing „Formel aktivieren“; short German coach hint when Beschwörung/EK summon legal
- [ ] Challenge: opponent construct shows own „Ziel“ control when legal CHALLENGE target; selecting sets pending attack target
- [ ] Replace/summon: `lastEvent` already set by engine; toast surfaces replace/beschworen feedback
- [ ] German UI; Styleguide; `npm run checks` green

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Empty construct → empty zone still visible (V6 only)
- [ ] No legal challenge vs construct → no Ziel button
- [ ] V5 / non-V6 matches → no construct zone
- [ ] Disturbed clears visually after owner Startphase tick (engine)

## Out of scope
- Default-Flip / Play-Default cutover
- Expanding locked Slice-1 105 catalog
- New activation UI path (reuse FORMULA_ACTIVATE)
- Construct card art pipeline / catalog content

## Security Coverage
- F-03: UI reads `player.construct` + legal CHALLENGE ids only; no invented rules
- P-04: local-only match state

## Regression
- [ ] FormulaRig / Echo-Delay / Fessel UI unchanged when construct null
- [ ] Engine constructs tests still pass
- [ ] V5 formula challenge path unaffected

## Assumptions (locked defaults)
1. Own construct zone on playmat (visible like formula slots)
2. Activation via existing formula activate (EK); short German coach hint OK
3. Challenge target: own icon/button on enemy construct
4. Disturbed visual like formula overlay
5. Haltbarkeit number always visible
6. Toast on replace + lastEvent

- Zone: `ConstructZone.tsx` beside FormulaRig (own + opponent); empty slot always on V6
- Challenge: Ziel button when construct instanceId in legal CHALLENGE targets; reuses attack pending
- Disturbed: „gestört“ header + grayscale like Formelplatz
- Haltbarkeit: always shown as badge when occupied
- Activation: existing FORMULA_ACTIVATE; coach hint when Beschwörung catalyst seated; preview „Konstrukt beschwören“
- Toast: `construct-summon` / „Konstrukt ersetzt“ from lastEvent via combatFeedbackCopy
- Docs: spielkonzept §8 / §99 / changelog; Spielregeln V6 Konstrukt-Zeile
- Glue: export `constructDisplayName` + Beschwörung id from `game/engine/v6`
